risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04r; BR-FUND-04 ⑧⑨). Supplement batches: launch runs the B2-04n validation for one bill and platform with settle_batches.kind = supplement and separate confirmation; recheckCurrentBill re-validates the current bill after credit.enabled goes off -> on. Same rules as B2-04n (current max snapshot version, BR-CALC-02 floor with tlj deduction, union_mismatch for settlement data without a WAITING order, recon diffs through ledger registerReconDiff, DRAFT only through the settle-batch transition, supplement items only in their order's platform batch, settle_jobs only through the settle-job transition and only granted columns). PARTIAL or switch-paused batches do not block an order from a supplement batch; double crediting is prevented by the ⑦ in-lock recheck and voucher uniq_keys (money round 1). A supplement launched on bill day shifts its run_at forward by 1 ms (with a warn) so it is never taken for the bill-day job's replay (D10-280 ①); settle_bills totals reflect only the bill-day job (D10-280 ③). Rejected when the bill is missing or still generating, or the switch is off.
